events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Liam Gallagher, the iconic frontman of Oasis and a successful solo artist, celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: Liam's Birthday
angles.copy: The one and only Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today. What's your favourite Oasis anthem or solo track from the rock 'n' roll star?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' released
events.blurb: John Lennon's seminal solo album 'Imagine' was released on this day in 1971.

angles.name: Imagine 1971
angles.copy: 55 years ago today, John Lennon released his powerful album 'Imagine'. A timeless message that resonates just as much now as it did then.

events.title: First iPod released 25 years ago
events.blurb: Apple launched the very first iPod on this day in 2001, revolutionising how we listen to music.

angles.name: iPod Anniversary
angles.copy: Remember the original iPod? 25 years ago today, Apple dropped this game-changer, putting '1,000 songs in your pocket'. How many did you own?

events.title: Global James Bond Day
events.blurb: Global James Bond Day celebrates the release of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Bond Day
angles.copy: It's James Bond Day! From iconic themes to unforgettable gadgets, which 007 film or song is your ultimate favourite? Licence to thrill all day long.

events.title: Remembering John Lennon on his 86th would-be birthday
events.blurb: Today would have marked the 86th birthday of The Beatles legend and peace activist, John Lennon.

angles.name: Lennon's Would-Be Birthday
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we're remembering the extraordinary life and music of John Lennon. His impact continues to inspire.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: British comedy icon John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Cleese's Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the legendary John Cleese! From silly walks to classic hotel chaos, what's your favourite moment from the comedy genius?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' released
events.blurb: The Beatles' ninth studio album, commonly known as 'The White Album', was released on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: 58 years ago today, The Beatles unleashed 'The White Album' on the world. Its eclectic mix still sounds incredible. What's your top track from the double LP?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury, 35 years on
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the passing of Queen's iconic frontman, Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80 this year.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Tribute
angles.copy: 35 years ago today, the world lost a true legend. Remembering the one and only Freddie Mercury, whose voice and stage presence remain unmatched. He would have been 80 this year.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' released
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: On this day in 1965, The Beatles dropped 'Rubber Soul', an album that marked a significant shift in their sound. What's your standout track?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon, 46 years on
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the tragic passing of music icon John Lennon.

angles.name: Lennon Death Anniversary
angles.copy: 46 years ago today, we lost John Lennon. His music and message of peace continue to resonate globally. Forever remembered.
